content.text: Users report that `iwe find --meta depends=foo` returns no results for bare frontmatter documents, even though those documents have a `depends:` field with `- foo` in their front matter. The same query works for documents with fenced YAML (---) front matter. All tests pass. Diagnose and fix. Ensure cargo test still passes after the fix.

content.text:
All done. Here's the summary:

## Root Cause

`wrap_bare_frontmatter()` in `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs` was filtering out indented lines from the YAML header block before wrapping it in `---` fences:

```rust
// BUG: strips lines starting with spaces — kills YAML list items like "  - foo"
header.lines().filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' ')).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n")
```

When a bare frontmatter document had a list-valued field like:

```yaml
title: Foo
depends:
  - bar
  - baz
```

The `  - bar` and `  - baz` lines were stripped before being passed to pulldown-cmark's YAML metadata parser. The resulting metadata was just `title: Foo\ndepends:` — no list items — so `--meta depends=bar` found nothing.

## Fix

Removed the line-filtering logic entirely. The header text extracted between the start of the file and the first blank line is valid YAML and should be passed through verbatim to the `---` fences. The fix reduced 15 lines to 5.

## Test

Added `metadata_matches_list_values_in_bare_frontmatter` to `crates/liwe/tests/bare_frontmatter_test.rs` — verifies that list-valued metadata fields in bare frontmatter documents are parsed correctly. All tests pass (9/9 in that file, full suite green).
